From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Stone <kelly.stone@acme.com>, Jordan F. <jordan.f@cloudworks.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@datascape.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lunch & Learn rotation plan — multi-prospect demo slots

Hi Kelly / Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for your interest in Redwood Inference. A few of our newer prospects asked if we could run a short lunch & learn demo series (30–40 minutes) aimed at practical inference economics: batching, routing, and cost tradeoffs. Instead of running one-off demos, we thought grouping 2–3 prospects per session and rotating them week-to-week would be efficient and more interactive.

Quick proposal:
- 30–40 minute live demo + 10 minutes for Q&A.
- Sessions run Monday–Thursday, 12:00–13:00 PT (15:00–16:00 ET) and a second wave at 17:00–18:00 PT (20:00–21:00 ET) for late west-coast / APAC-friendly attendees.
- We’ll cap groups at 3 prospects. Each week we rotate who gets the "spotlight" (10 minutes to present their use case).

I attached a very small rotation matrix (rotation_matrix.csv) with tentative slots and a draft invite template (invite_template.ics). Could you reply with which of these windows works for you, and whether you prefer the earlier or later wave? If one of the companies needs a shorter 20-minute focused run, tell us and we’ll accommodate.

Next steps for us internally: Marissa will assemble the round-robin plan and Ben will issue calendar invites once we lock slots.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you on a session.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
[Attachment: rotation_matrix.csv (CSV)]

Hi Rafael —

Thanks — this sounds useful. For Acme: 12:00–13:00 PT works best. We have a tight calendar the week of 10/4, so earlier slots before then are preferable. Also, we’d prefer a short 25–30 minute demo focused on cost/throughput for our batch scoring use case — followed by Q&A.

Two quick asks:
1) Can you add a column to the rotation matrix for our preferred agenda (batch scoring)?
2) Could you avoid sharing customer usage details during the call — we’ll keep our use case high-level.

Appreciate it — Kelly
